details:
- CVE-2026-53800: --remove-source-files could delete a file outside the
  source tree through a parent directory swapped for a symlink
- CVE-2026-119741: a receiver supplying weak checksums that collide with
  consecutive rolling windows made the sender compute a strong checksum at
  every byte offset
- Fix a signed overflow of the --inplace aligned block index in
  hash_search() on source files over 2 GiB
- Refuse a symlinked --link-dest/--compare-dest/--copy-dest basis on a
  pulling client, allow --read-batch from a FIFO, and let a non-root
  receiver enter a search-only destination directory
- Fix rrsync regressions in the CVE-2026-53783 fix: listing the
  restricted root as /, pushing onto an existing file, and a
  --delay-updates --partial-dir push
